verdict.rationale: New Relic's docs say you can instrument services with OpenTelemetry for "platform-agnostic observability" and ingest that OTel data into the platform. That covers the instrument-once-with-open-standards part. The backend-switching part rests only on the "platform-agnostic" claim: no docs show moving the same instrumentation between backends without code changes, and the primary path is still proprietary language agents. Missing for 10: documented OTLP endpoint/exporter configuration showing backend swap without re-instrumentation, migration guidance from proprietary agents to OTel, independent or hands-on corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: Instrument your service with OpenTelemetry and gain platform-agnostic observability.
By integrating OpenTelemetry with New Relic, you can leverage a wide range of platform capabilities to analyze the data and diagnose problems.
